propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate took nine customer warehouses live on the goods-to-person robotics system between 2021 and 2025, running the cut-over from manual picking and the first live picking shift at each site.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the go-live plan document the go-lives and cut-overs.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the hypercare fortnight at all nine sites with the customer's shift leaders and handled the stoppages raised during hypercare, as recorded in each site's stoppage log.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the stoppage log document the hypercare and the stoppages.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate coordinated the installation schedule with field engineering before each go-live, ran the pre-go-live acceptance tests with the customer, and wrote the site closure report for each warehouse.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the acceptance record and the closure report document the schedule, the tests and the reports.

expectedGap: None; the materials document the go-lives, the hypercare, the installation coordination, the acceptance tests and the closure reports.
expectedBoundaryNote: The go-lives, cut-overs and hypercare are documented in the resume and the site records; keep the site count and the stages as stated.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the site numbers of the nine warehouses so the stoppage logs can be checked.
